gen-dafont-plakkaat-gf-kadwa: Plakkaat is all heavy, closed shapes, its outlines drawn like bent straw with a steady unshaded line. Kadwa follows as a text serif with open-ended curves and a big x-height, letting the page breathe after the weight above.
gen-dafont-plakkaat-gf-noticia-text: Those curled terminals that nearly touch the stem give Plakkaat a chunky, looped swagger. Noticia Text settles into a text serif rhythm, its lowercase filling most of the line height, so a long page feels literary and dignified.
gen-dafont-plakkaat-gf-pridi: Pridi reads like a classic serif with refinement, its small letters standing proud and nearly capital-sized. Against the closed, heavy forms of Plakkaat, its open curves make the strongest single quality of the pair.
gen-dafont-plakkaat-inter: Plakkaat's terminals sweep around until they nearly touch the stem, giving the heading a bent-straw bulk. Inter does the opposite job, with big counters and a smooth tube-like line that keep the sans-serif text easy to move through.
gen-dafont-plakkaat-mulish: Heavy and tightly closed, Plakkaat looks nearly sealed shut. Mulish is a modern, friendly sans with no thick-to-thin shifts and horseshoe-open apertures, and that openness against the heading's bulk is what stands out most.
gen-dafont-quantum-fs-bespoke-sans: Crisp, techy and loosely spaced, Quantum looks cleanly futuristic. Bespoke Sans is a sharp, refined sans with generous room where curves meet the stem, so a longer passage reads smoothly.
gen-dafont-quantum-gf-fauna-one: Quantum brings a clean, techy look, every glyph drawn with one flat line weight. Fauna One, a literary serif with a tall middle band and shallow ascenders, makes a longer passage feel dignified and settled.
gen-dafont-quantum-gf-glegoo: Refined and editorial, Glegoo is the body here. Its classic serif curves stay wide open and its lowercase runs tall, which gives Quantum's loose, compressed-ascender techy heading a warm counterpart.
gen-dafont-quantum-gf-hanuman: Quantum sets out a clean, tech-minded heading with zero stroke contrast and generous spacing. And Hanuman, a traditional, refined serif with a high-waisted lowercase, handles the quieter text work with wide-set terminals on its s.
gen-dafont-quantum-gf-kadwa: Kadwa is a classic text serif with a large x-height. Beside Quantum's tube-like line, which holds its thickness through every bend, the old-fashioned editorial warmth of the body becomes the strongest quality of the pair.
